summary: Lease agreement vs sale transaction; Nazul land transfer without lessor consent; Delhi Development Act s.22 and 1981 Rules compliance; unregistered lease invalidating subsequent transfers; auction sale confirmation improper without title verification; liquidation proceedings affecting fund allocation; unearned income payment obligation; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Development Authority (Disposal of Developed Nazul Land) Rules, 1981 Rule 43
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Division Bench judgment set aside; auction sale confirmation quashed; remanded for determination of unearned income payment.
